//: herdr-orchestrator's add-ons (everything is a plugin): each feature, what it is made of and what it needs.
core is always installed and always on. Every add-on is installed too (one layout gives everything);
one with "switch": true can be turned off in herdr-orchestrator settings > Window. The off list is shared
An add-on without a switch is always on in 0.1.0: splitting it from the panels it lives in comes later.
mods: folders under mods/. blocks: layout node ids it fills. keys: "<context> <key>" in keys.json. web: the web app's plugins (web/plugins), left out while it is off.
helpers: links put in ~/.local/bin. templates: ~/.config/herdr-core/templates. needs: other add-ons.

core.title: Core
core.about: The herdr-orchestrator layout: sidebar, tab bar, chat pane header, status bar, toasts, menus, dialogs and these settings.

addons.title: Tasks
addons.about: The Tasks panel, the Accept card and herdr-task: every task with its own agent, worktree, review and merge.

addons.title: Orchestrators
addons.about: A coordinator for every space that turns what you write into tasks, and tells you their news.

addons.title: Chat
addons.about: Agents as a chat, with cards, attachments, model choice and opened images.

addons.title: Questions and permissions
addons.about: An agent's question or permission prompt comes to the chat as a card (Claude Code and Codex hooks).

addons.title: Secrets
addons.about: Agents ask for a key by name; you type it into a masked card and it goes straight to a private vault.

addons.title: Artifacts
addons.about: Reports and draft screens from agents, beside the chat, with markup. Off: no Artifacts panel button.

addons.title: Voice and dictation
addons.about: Call an Orchestrator and talk (an ElevenLabs key), and dictate into the box (the same key). Off: no call or mic buttons.

addons.title: Reactions
addons.about: React to an agent's message with an emoji. Off: no smiley button (agents' own reactions still show).

addons.title: Task browser
addons.about: Each task gets its own browser you can watch and take over. Off: no Browser tab, and workers aren't given one.

addons.title: Autopilot
addons.about: An Orchestrator works on its own between your messages, from its heartbeat. Off: no Autopilot switch, and no wake-ups.

addons.title: Other machines
addons.about: Keeps herdr-task, its helpers and the role templates the same on every connected machine, and maps their Orchestrators. Off: nothing is sent, the Orchestrator map stays on this machine and Find machines is off.

addons.title: Usage insights
addons.about: A private log of how you use herdr-orchestrator (screens, switches, buttons and times, never your words), kept only on your own machines so your Orchestrator can suggest better ways to work when you ask. It is never sent to herdr-orchestrator's makers or anyone else. Off: nothing is recorded.

addons.title: Web
addons.about: herdr-orchestrator in your browser on phone, tablet and desktop, private to your tailnet. Off: the web app stops; the service keeps working.
